description: Proposing Redis sessions when they were already removed — should block
design: Store session data in Redis with a 30-minute TTL and auto-extend on activity. Use express-session with connect-redis.

oracle_evidence.key_insight: Redis sessions removed due to memory overhead at scale and operational complexity
oracle_evidence.decision: Redis sessions removed — memory overhead at scale was unsustainable and operational complexity (Redis cluster, failover) added too much risk
